services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: We have everything you need for a successful field trip for children up to age 8. With 17 hands-on exhibits to explore, your group is sure to find plenty to investigate and discover during their visit. Discounted group rates are available for field trips with confirmation from the Museum. A limited number of field trip scholarships are available to classrooms serving high populations of children receiving free or reduced lunches.
